title: Malicious code in @c1-ease/commerce (npm)
description: The npm package @c1-ease/commerce versions 2.0.0 and 2.0.1 contains malicious code that executes a post-install script and a runtime callback beacon. This beacon sends host identifiers such as hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node.js version to a suspicious external server with disabled TLS verification. The package acts as a compatibility shim with no legitimate functionality, and the beacon fires automatically on install and import without user consent. This behavior is consistent with a dependency confusion or namespace squatting attempt targeting internal @c1-ease packages.
